instruction: Low-angle cinematic wide shot. On an outdoor rooftop against a clear blue sky, five friends stand side-by-side. From left to right: the woman in the white t-shirt and gray sweater (R1) stands looking forward; the woman in the black crop top and white shirt (R5) looks to the right; the woman in the denim vest and white pants (R3) stands in the center with her arms raised joyfully; the man in the gray t-shirt (R2) stands looking to the right; and the man in the green jacket and black hat (R4) stands on the far right looking away. Bright daylight casts soft shadows across the group.
